term.key: Best, Top, Main, Principal, Highest, Ranking, N most, N top, N best

mapping.term: SEMANTIC ORDERING: When user asks for N best/top/main/highest in any dimension (customers, products, suppliers, employees, etc.), ALWAYS order by the most relevant metric descending (ORDER BY ... DESC) and limit to N. NEVER use alphabetical order (name) as default. Examples: "10 best customers" → ORDER BY sum(amount_untaxed) DESC LIMIT 10; "top 5 products" → ORDER BY qty_sold DESC LIMIT 5; "main suppliers" → ORDER BY sum(purchase_total) DESC. If metric is not explicit in the question, infer billing total (sum of amount_untaxed or amount_total on posted invoices).
